label: prop:skein-bar-antisymmetry
title: Skein relation $L_+ - L_- = (q - q^{-1})\,L_0$ is bar-antisymmetric
html:
The Hecke--Skein relation

  L_+ - L_-  =  (q - q^{-1})\,L_0
  \tag{S}

in the Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_n(q) is antisymmetric under the bar involution

  \overline{\,\cdot\,} \colon
  (L_+,\,L_-,\,L_0,\,q)
  \;\longmapsto\;
  (L_-,\,L_+,\,L_0,\,q^{-1}).

Applying \overline{\,\cdot\,} to both sides of (S) yields -1 times (S):

  \overline{L_+ - L_-}  =  L_- - L_+
   =  -\,(L_+ - L_-),
  \qquad
  \overline{(q - q^{-1})\,L_0}
   =  (q^{-1} - q)\,L_0
   =  -\,(q - q^{-1})\,L_0.
heading: Proposition
